SELECT PUR_EnquiryHeader.DocumentNo AS EnquiryNumber, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AS RequisitionNumber, PUR_EnquiryDetail.SerialNo, PUR_EnquiryHeader.CreatedByValue AS PreparedBy, PUR_QuotationHeader.DocumentNo AS QuotationNumber, PUR_EnquiryDetail.Quantity AS EnquiredQuantity, PUR_EnquiryDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description AS ItemName, PUR_QuotationDetail.OfferedQuantity, PUR_QuotationHeader.SupplierID, (PUR_QuotationDetail.OfferedQuantity) AS QuotedQuantity, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName, PUR_QuotationDetail.QuotedPrice, PUR_QuotationDetail.NegotiationPrice1,PUR_QuotationDetail.NegotiationPrice2, (case when (NegotiationPrice1 > 0 and NegotiationPrice1 < NegotiationPrice2) then NegotiationPrice1 else NegotiationPrice2 end * PUR_QuotationDetail.OfferedQuantity) as Amount, PUR_QuotationDetail.Approved, PUR_QuotationDetail.Specs as BrandName, SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName , isnull(PUR_QuotationHeader.GST,0) As GST , isnull(PUR_QuotationHeader.DeliveryPeriod,0) As DeliveryPeriod, IsNull(PUR_QuotationHeader.PlaceOfDelivery,0) As PlaceOfDelivery , IsNull(PUR_QuotationHeader.PaymentMode,0) As PaymentMode,
( Select top 1 AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.UnitPrice from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail Inner join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.FiscalID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.FiscalID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1
left JOIN PUR_QuotationHeader QH ON QH.CompanyID = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].CompanyID AND QH.PeriodID = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].PeriodID AND QH.DocumentNo = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].VendorQuoteNumber AND QH.FiscalID = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].FiscalID
left JOIN PUR_EnquiryHeader EH ON EH.CompanyID = QH.CompanyID AND EH.PeriodID = QH.PeriodID AND EH.EnquiryID = QH.EnquiryHeaderID
WHere AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.ItemID and isnull(EH.DocumentNo,0) <> PUR_EnquiryHeader.DocumentNo and DocumentNumber < isnull(( Select max(DocumentNumber) as DocumentNumber from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail Inner join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.FiscalID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.FiscalID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1
inner JOIN PUR_QuotationHeader QH ON QH.CompanyID = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].CompanyID AND QH.PeriodID = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].PeriodID AND QH.DocumentNo = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].VendorQuoteNumber AND QH.FiscalID = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].FiscalID
inner JOIN PUR_EnquiryHeader EH ON EH.CompanyID = QH.CompanyID AND EH.PeriodID = QH.PeriodID AND EH.EnquiryID = QH.EnquiryHeaderID
WHere AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.ItemID and EH.DocumentNo = PUR_EnquiryHeader.DocumentNo ),99999) Order by AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate desc,AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CreateDate desc ) as LastPrice,
( Select top 1 DocumentNumber from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail Inner join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.FiscalID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.FiscalID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1
left JOIN PUR_QuotationHeader QH ON QH.CompanyID = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].CompanyID AND QH.PeriodID = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].PeriodID AND QH.DocumentNo = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].VendorQuoteNumber AND QH.FiscalID = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].FiscalID
left JOIN PUR_EnquiryHeader EH ON EH.CompanyID = QH.CompanyID AND EH.PeriodID = QH.PeriodID AND EH.EnquiryID = QH.EnquiryHeaderID
WHere AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.ItemID and isnull(EH.DocumentNo,0) <> PUR_EnquiryHeader.DocumentNo and DocumentNumber < isnull(( Select max(DocumentNumber) as DocumentNumber from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail Inner join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.FiscalID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.FiscalID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1
inner JOIN PUR_QuotationHeader QH ON QH.CompanyID = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].CompanyID AND QH.PeriodID = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].PeriodID AND QH.DocumentNo = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].VendorQuoteNumber AND QH.FiscalID = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].FiscalID
inner JOIN PUR_EnquiryHeader EH ON EH.CompanyID = QH.CompanyID AND EH.PeriodID = QH.PeriodID AND EH.EnquiryID = QH.EnquiryHeaderID
WHere AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.ItemID and EH.DocumentNo = PUR_EnquiryHeader.DocumentNo ),99999) Order by AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate desc,AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CreateDate desc )as LastPO,
( Select top 1 DocumentDate from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail Inner join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.FiscalID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.FiscalID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1
left JOIN PUR_QuotationHeader QH ON QH.CompanyID = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].CompanyID AND QH.PeriodID = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].PeriodID AND QH.DocumentNo = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].VendorQuoteNumber AND QH.FiscalID = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].FiscalID
left JOIN PUR_EnquiryHeader EH ON EH.CompanyID = QH.CompanyID AND EH.PeriodID = QH.PeriodID AND EH.EnquiryID = QH.EnquiryHeaderID
WHere AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = 1 and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = 1 and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.ItemID and isnull(EH.DocumentNo,0) <> PUR_EnquiryHeader.DocumentNo and DocumentNumber < isnull(( Select max(DocumentNumber) as DocumentNumber from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail Inner join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.FiscalID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.FiscalID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1
inner JOIN PUR_QuotationHeader QH ON QH.CompanyID = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].CompanyID AND QH.PeriodID = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].PeriodID AND QH.DocumentNo = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].VendorQuoteNumber AND QH.FiscalID = [AP_PurchaseOrderHeader].FiscalID
inner JOIN PUR_EnquiryHeader EH ON EH.CompanyID = QH.CompanyID AND EH.PeriodID = QH.PeriodID AND EH.EnquiryID = QH.EnquiryHeaderID
WHere AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = 1 and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = 1 and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.ItemID and EH.DocumentNo = PUR_EnquiryHeader.DocumentNo ),99999) Order by AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate desc,AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CreateDate desc ) as LastPoDate,
(select top 1 CustomerName from AP_PurchaseOrderDetail inner join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID where AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.ItemID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status=1 order by AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CreateDate desc) LastPoSupplier ,
(select sum(isnull(TransactionQuantity,0)) * -1 from INV_StockTransactionDetail inner join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID in (Select MenuID from ApplicationMenu where MenuPath='/Inventory/Transaction/Average/StockGIN_frm.aspx' )
where INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.ItemID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1
) Consumption,
(select sum(isnull(TransactionQuantity,0)) * -1 from INV_StockTransactionDetail inner join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = (select Top (1) FiscalId from SET_PeriodCustom where CompanyID = @CompanyID And FiscalId < @CurrentFiscalID ORDER BY FiscalId desc)
INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.MenuID in (Select MenuID from ApplicationMenu where MenuPath ='/Inventory/Transaction/Average/StockGIN_frm.aspx' )
where INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.ItemID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1 ) LastYearConsumption,
( select sum(SumOfQuantityInStock ) from ( select --IsNull(Sum(Case when Set_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'No Impact' then 0 else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity END), 0) As SumOfQuantityInStock case when StkDetail.ImpactID is not null then case StkDetail.ImpactID when 1 then abs(SUM(StkDetail.TransactionQuantity)) when 2 then abs(SUM(StkDetail.TransactionQuantity)) *-1 end else case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'Positive' then abs(SUM(StkDetail.TransactionQuantity)) when 'Negative' then abs(SUM(StkDetail.TransactionQuantity)) *-1 end end As SumOfQuantityInStock
from INV_StockTransactionDetail StkDetail Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader StkHdr On StkHdr.StockTransactionID = StkDetail.StockTransactionID AND StkHdr.CompanyID = StkDetail.CompanyID And StkDetail.PeriodID = StkHdr.PeriodID
inner JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = StkHdr.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = StkHdr.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = StkHdr.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 --And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' AND ((SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Stock Adjustment') or (SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact') )
LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = StkHdr.LocationID
LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = [StkDetail].LocationID
where StkDetail.ItemID = INV_Item.ItemID And StkDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StkDetail.PeriodID = 1 And StkDetail.Status = 1 And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' and StkDetail.ItemID = INV_Item.ItemID And StkDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And StkDetail.PeriodID = 1 And StkDetail.Status = 1 And StkHdr.Status = 1 --AND (isnull(SET_Location.LocationID,SL.LocationID) = INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationID OR INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationID is null) AND (isnull(SET_Location.LocationID,SL.LocationID) = isnull(INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.locationID) OR isnull(INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.locationID) is null) AND StkDetail.IsActive = 1 AND StkHdr.StatusCode = 1 AND StkHdr.ReversalID IS NULL group by StkDetail.ImpactID,SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact,StkHdr.DocumentNo,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType )as tab )As CurrentStock,
Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodTypeName CurrentYear, (select Top (1) PeriodTypeName from SET_PeriodCustom where CompanyID = @CompanyID And FiscalId < @CurrentFiscalID ORDER BY FiscalId desc) as LastYear,
1 As Sort, @IsSuppress AS IsSuppress, --@PreparedBy AS PreparedBy, @PurchaseOfficer AS PurchaseOfficer, @DeputyManagerOfficer AS DeputyManagerOfficer, @Director AS Director ,PUR_QuotationHeader.Comments ManagerPurchase --, @ManagerPurchase AS ManagerPurchase FROM PUR_QuotationDetail INNER JOIN PUR_QuotationHeader ON PUR_QuotationHeader.CompanyID = PUR_QuotationDetail.CompanyID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.PeriodID = PUR_QuotationDetail.PeriodID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.QuotationID = PUR_QuotationDetail.QuotationHeaderID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN PUR_EnquiryDetail ON PUR_EnquiryDetail.CompanyID = PUR_QuotationDetail.CompanyID AND PUR_EnquiryDetail.PeriodID = PUR_QuotationDetail.PeriodID AND PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryHeaderID = PUR_QuotationDetail.EnquiryHeaderID AND PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryDetailID = PUR_QuotationDetail.EnquiryDetailID AND PUR_EnquiryDetail.Status = 1 INNER JOIN PUR_EnquiryHeader ON PUR_EnquiryHeader.CompanyID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.CompanyID AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.PeriodID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.PeriodID AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.EnquiryID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryHeaderID AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.Status = 1
inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = PUR_EnquiryHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = PUR_EnquiryHeader.CompanyID
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = PUR_EnquiryHeader.FK_Inv_StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = PUR_EnquiryHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = PUR_EnquiryHeader.PeriodID
left join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID
INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.ItemID --INV_Item.CompanyID = PUR_QuotationDetail.CompanyID AND INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = PUR_QuotationHeader.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = PUR_QuotationHeader.SupplierID INNER JOIN SET_UnitOfMeasure ON SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.ItemUnitID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on PUR_QuotationHeader.QuotedDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID WHERE PUR_QuotationDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND PUR_QuotationDetail.Status = 1 AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.DocumentNo BETWEEN @RFQNumberFrom AND @RFQNumberTo AND (PUR_EnquiryHeader.DocumentTYpeID = @DocumentTYpeID OR @DocumentTYpeID is Null)
SELECT PUR_EnquiryHeader.DocumentNo AS EnquiryNumber, '1. Delivery Period:' AS RowsCrossTabb, PUR_QuotationHeader.SupplierID, ( Case When PUR_QuotationHeader.DeliveryPeriod Is Null Then '' Else Cast(PUR_QuotationHeader.DeliveryPeriod As Varchar) + ' ' + ' Days' End ) AS SummaryCrossTab, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName FROM PUR_QuotationHeader INNER JOIN PUR_QuotationDetail ON PUR_QuotationHeader.CompanyID = PUR_QuotationDetail.CompanyID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.PeriodID = PUR_QuotationDetail.PeriodID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.QuotationID = PUR_QuotationDetail.QuotationHeaderID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = PUR_QuotationHeader.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = PUR_QuotationHeader.SupplierID INNER JOIN PUR_EnquiryDetail ON PUR_EnquiryDetail.CompanyID = PUR_QuotationDetail.CompanyID AND PUR_EnquiryDetail.PeriodID = PUR_QuotationDetail.PeriodID AND PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryHeaderID = PUR_QuotationDetail.EnquiryHeaderID AND PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryDetailID = PUR_QuotationDetail.EnquiryDetailID AND PUR_EnquiryDetail.Status = 1 INNER JOIN PUR_EnquiryHeader ON PUR_EnquiryHeader.CompanyID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.CompanyID AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.PeriodID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.PeriodID AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.EnquiryID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryHeaderID AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.Status = 1 inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = PUR_EnquiryHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = PUR_EnquiryHeader.CompanyID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on PUR_QuotationHeader.QuotedDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID WHERE PUR_QuotationHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.Status = 1 AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.DocumentNo BETWEEN @RFQNumberFrom AND @RFQNumberTo AND (PUR_EnquiryHeader.DocumentTYpeID = @DocumentTYpeID OR @DocumentTYpeID is Null)
Union All
SELECT PUR_EnquiryHeader.DocumentNo AS EnquiryNumber, '2. Payment:' AS RowsCrossTabb, PUR_QuotationHeader.SupplierID, IsNull(PUR_QuotationHeader.PaymentMode,'') AS SummaryCrossTab, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName FROM PUR_QuotationHeader INNER JOIN PUR_QuotationDetail ON PUR_QuotationHeader.CompanyID = PUR_QuotationDetail.CompanyID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.PeriodID = PUR_QuotationDetail.PeriodID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.QuotationID = PUR_QuotationDetail.QuotationHeaderID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = PUR_QuotationHeader.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = PUR_QuotationHeader.SupplierID INNER JOIN PUR_EnquiryDetail ON PUR_EnquiryDetail.CompanyID = PUR_QuotationDetail.CompanyID AND PUR_EnquiryDetail.PeriodID = PUR_QuotationDetail.PeriodID AND PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryHeaderID = PUR_QuotationDetail.EnquiryHeaderID AND PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryDetailID = PUR_QuotationDetail.EnquiryDetailID AND PUR_EnquiryDetail.Status = 1 INNER JOIN PUR_EnquiryHeader ON PUR_EnquiryHeader.CompanyID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.CompanyID AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.PeriodID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.PeriodID AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.EnquiryID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryHeaderID AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.Status = 1 inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = PUR_EnquiryHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = PUR_EnquiryHeader.CompanyID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on PUR_QuotationHeader.QuotedDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID WHERE PUR_QuotationHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.Status = 1 AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.DocumentNo BETWEEN @RFQNumberFrom AND @RFQNumberTo AND (PUR_EnquiryHeader.DocumentTYpeID = @DocumentTYpeID OR @DocumentTYpeID is Null)
Union All
SELECT PUR_EnquiryHeader.DocumentNo AS EnquiryNumber, '3. Transportation Charges:' AS RowsCrossTabb, PUR_QuotationHeader.SupplierID, IsNull(PUR_QuotationHeader.PlaceOfDelivery,'') AS SummaryCrossTab, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName FROM PUR_QuotationHeader INNER JOIN PUR_QuotationDetail ON PUR_QuotationHeader.CompanyID = PUR_QuotationDetail.CompanyID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.PeriodID = PUR_QuotationDetail.PeriodID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.QuotationID = PUR_QuotationDetail.QuotationHeaderID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = PUR_QuotationHeader.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = PUR_QuotationHeader.SupplierID INNER JOIN PUR_EnquiryDetail ON PUR_EnquiryDetail.CompanyID = PUR_QuotationDetail.CompanyID AND PUR_EnquiryDetail.PeriodID = PUR_QuotationDetail.PeriodID AND PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryHeaderID = PUR_QuotationDetail.EnquiryHeaderID AND PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryDetailID = PUR_QuotationDetail.EnquiryDetailID AND PUR_EnquiryDetail.Status = 1 INNER JOIN PUR_EnquiryHeader ON PUR_EnquiryHeader.CompanyID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.CompanyID AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.PeriodID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.PeriodID AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.EnquiryID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryHeaderID AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.Status = 1 inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = PUR_EnquiryHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = PUR_EnquiryHeader.CompanyID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on PUR_QuotationHeader.QuotedDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID WHERE PUR_QuotationHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.Status = 1 AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.DocumentNo BETWEEN @RFQNumberFrom AND @RFQNumberTo AND (PUR_EnquiryHeader.DocumentTYpeID = @DocumentTYpeID OR @DocumentTYpeID is Null)
Union All
SELECT PUR_EnquiryHeader.DocumentNo AS EnquiryNumber, '4. Comments:' AS RowsCrossTabb, PUR_QuotationHeader.SupplierID, IsNull(PUR_EnquiryHeader.Comments,'') AS SummaryCrossTab, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName FROM PUR_QuotationHeader INNER JOIN PUR_QuotationDetail ON PUR_QuotationHeader.CompanyID = PUR_QuotationDetail.CompanyID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.PeriodID = PUR_QuotationDetail.PeriodID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.QuotationID = PUR_QuotationDetail.QuotationHeaderID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = PUR_QuotationHeader.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = PUR_QuotationHeader.SupplierID INNER JOIN PUR_EnquiryDetail ON PUR_EnquiryDetail.CompanyID = PUR_QuotationDetail.CompanyID AND PUR_EnquiryDetail.PeriodID = PUR_QuotationDetail.PeriodID AND PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryHeaderID = PUR_QuotationDetail.EnquiryHeaderID AND PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryDetailID = PUR_QuotationDetail.EnquiryDetailID AND PUR_EnquiryDetail.Status = 1 INNER JOIN PUR_EnquiryHeader ON PUR_EnquiryHeader.CompanyID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.CompanyID AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.PeriodID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.PeriodID AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.EnquiryID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryHeaderID AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.Status = 1 inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = PUR_EnquiryHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = PUR_EnquiryHeader.CompanyID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on PUR_QuotationHeader.QuotedDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID WHERE PUR_QuotationHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.Status = 1 AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.DocumentNo BETWEEN @RFQNumberFrom AND @RFQNumberTo AND (PUR_EnquiryHeader.DocumentTYpeID = @DocumentTYpeID OR @DocumentTYpeID is Null)
SELECT PUR_EnquiryHeader.DocumentNo AS EnquiryNumber, '1-Sub Total' AS RowsCrossTabb, PUR_QuotationHeader.SupplierID, SUM((case when (NegotiationPrice1 > 0 and NegotiationPrice1 < NegotiationPrice2) then NegotiationPrice1 else NegotiationPrice2 end * PUR_QuotationDetail.OfferedQuantity)) as SummaryCrossTab, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName ,1 as SortOrder FROM PUR_QuotationHeader INNER JOIN PUR_QuotationDetail ON PUR_QuotationHeader.CompanyID = PUR_QuotationDetail.CompanyID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.PeriodID = PUR_QuotationDetail.PeriodID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.QuotationID = PUR_QuotationDetail.QuotationHeaderID AND PUR_QuotationDetail.Status = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = PUR_QuotationHeader.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = PUR_QuotationHeader.SupplierID INNER JOIN PUR_EnquiryDetail ON PUR_EnquiryDetail.CompanyID = PUR_QuotationDetail.CompanyID AND PUR_EnquiryDetail.PeriodID = PUR_QuotationDetail.PeriodID AND PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryHeaderID = PUR_QuotationDetail.EnquiryHeaderID AND PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryDetailID = PUR_QuotationDetail.EnquiryDetailID AND PUR_EnquiryDetail.Status = 1 INNER JOIN PUR_EnquiryHeader ON PUR_EnquiryHeader.CompanyID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.CompanyID AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.PeriodID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.PeriodID AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.EnquiryID = PUR_EnquiryDetail.EnquiryHeaderID AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.Status = 1 inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = PUR_EnquiryHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = PUR_EnquiryHeader.CompanyID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on PUR_QuotationHeader.QuotedDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID WHERE PUR_QuotationHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.Status = 1 AND PUR_EnquiryHeader.DocumentNo BETWEEN @RFQNumberFrom AND @RFQNumberTo AND (PUR_EnquiryHeader.DocumentTYpeID = @DocumentTYpeID OR @DocumentTYpeID is Null)
group by PUR_EnquiryHeader.DocumentNo ,PUR_QuotationHeader.SupplierID,PUR_QuotationHeader.DeliveryPeriod,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName
union all
SELECT PUR_EnquiryHeader.DocumentNo AS EnquiryNumber, case when PUR_QuotationHeader.GST is null then '2-Sale Tax ' else '2-Sale Tax (' + convert(varchar ,PUR_QuotationHeader.GST) + '%)' end AS RowsCrossTabb, PUR_QuotationHeader.SupplierID, SUM((case when (NegotiationPrice1 > 0 and NegotiationPrice1 < NegotiationPrice2) then NegotiationPrice1 else NegotiationPrice2 end * PUR_QuotationDetail.OfferedQuantity)) * ISNULL(GST,0) / 100 as SummaryCrossTab, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS SupplierName ,2 as SortOrder FROM PUR_QuotationHeader INNER JOIN PUR_QuotationDetail ON PUR_QuotationHeader.CompanyID = PUR_QuotationDetail.CompanyID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.PeriodID = PUR_QuotationDetail.PeriodID AND PUR_QuotationHeader.QuotationID =
